wiki.title: Tammy Nuccio
wiki.extract: Tammy Nuccio (born 1971) is an American politician currently serving as a Connecticut State Representative from the 53rd District, which encompasses the towns of Tolland, and Willington as well as part of Vernon. A member of the Republican Party, Nuccio was first elected to the seat in 2020 after defeating Democratic Incumbent Pat Wilson Pheanious.
